unitSeparation.rowCopies: References to envelope objects copied into language-level array elements; no payload cloning is implied.
unitSeparation.arrayObjects: Different category from element count; even zero-row filter/fallback arrays create source-level array objects. Exact counts and actual heap allocations are unmeasured.
unitSeparation.cpu: Comparisons, recursion, calls, allocation, GC and other work have different costs. Counter inequalities and negative/positive heap deltas do not prove CPU savings or regression.
unitSeparation.bytes: Slot widths, capacity growth, array headers, allocator behavior and GC are not measured. Do not multiply reference counts by an assumed pointer width to claim allocated bytes.
